content: DO Spaces image upload via boto3: same client pattern as existing spaces.py (endpoint, region, credentials). For images, use upload_fileobj with ContentType set to image/jpeg or image/png. ACL: DO Spaces supports object-level public-read ACL via x-amz-acl header, but there are documented cases where ACL is ignored — use ACL='public-read' in ExtraArgs but verify. There is a known community-reported issue where PutObject ACL header is ignored; bucket-level public policy is more reliable for a public-facing photo bucket. For profile photos, simplest pattern: upload with ACL='public-read' and use the direct CDN URL (https://<bucket>.<region>.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/<key>) for serving; no presigned URL needed for public content.
